summary: Suburban Propane Partners, L.P. filed an 8-K on April 23, 2026, disclosing its Fiscal 2026 Second Quarter Distribution Declaration via a press release. The board declared a quarterly distribution of $0.325 per common unit, or $1.30 annualized, payable May 12, 2026, to holders of record May 5, 2026. The filing is a routine current report on a regular cash distribution, with no special-situation transaction, activist activity, or structural change. It includes disclosure under Items 7.01 and 8.01 and an FD notice to foreign investors regarding withholding. No deal terms or special situation analysis applies.
